# The bathtub, its water, its claw feet. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Enamel --base-color 0.8235 0.7882 0.6471 --no-slot
material new Water --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
material new Brass --base-color 0.7294 0.5686 0.3451 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Tub --size 1 --location 0 0 0.65
scale 9.2 5.4 1.3
apply --scale
material assign Enamel
active Tub
mode edit
select edge where "abs(pos.z - 0.65) < 0.01"
bevel 1.0 --segments 3
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
inset 0.35
extrude 0 0 -0.45
material assign Water
uv project-from-view top --scale-to-bounds
mode object
material texture Water base-color textures/water.png
add mesh uv-sphere --name Foot1 --segments 6 --rings 4 --radius 0.3 --location 3.5 1.9 0.12
add mesh uv-sphere --name Foot2 --segments 6 --rings 4 --radius 0.3 --location -3.5 1.9 0.12
add mesh uv-sphere --name Foot3 --segments 6 --rings 4 --radius 0.3 --location 3.5 -1.9 0.12
add mesh uv-sphere --name Foot4 --segments 6 --rings 4 --radius 0.3 --location -3.5 -1.9 0.12
select Foot1 Foot2 Foot3 Foot4
material assign Brass
select all
shade flat
export tub.glb
